label: Море
description: Twelve-mission case drill for море (sea) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form море stands as the subject. Soft neuter nouns end in -е in the nominative, and for inanimate neuters this form also serves as the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative море shifts to моря. The preposition около governs the genitive; soft neuter -е nouns take -я in the genitive singular.

missions.phrase: Мы едем к морю на лето.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative singular. Море takes the dative ending морю. The preposition к, marking movement toward a goal, governs the dative; soft neuter nouns take -ю here.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of люблю is море, identical to the nominative. For inanimate neuter nouns the accusative always matches the nominative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The nominative море becomes морем. The preposition над, marking position above, governs the instrumental; soft neuter nouns take -ем.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. Море keeps its -е form after на, since soft neuter nouns already end in -е. The prepositional marks location and never appears without a preposition.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject is моря. Soft neuter nouns form the nominative plural in -я, shifting the stress onto the ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The soft stem yields морей rather than a zero ending. Negation нет triggers the genitive; soft neuter -е nouns take the -ей ending in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. Моря becomes морям. The preposition к governs the dative; the dative plural ending -ям follows soft stems for all genders.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object моря matches the nominative plural. Since море is inanimate, the accusative plural equals the nominative plural.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The plural моря takes the ending морями. The preposition между governs the instrumental; soft stems take -ями in the instrumental plural.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. Моря shifts to морях after в. The prepositional plural ending -ях follows soft stems for all genders and always requires a preposition.
